faqSection.subtitleTemplate: Everything you need to know about hiring the {name} in Dubai.

q1.question: How much does it cost to hire {name} with chauffeur in Dubai?
q1.answer: Chauffeur-driven rates for the {name} are shown in the packages above, covering hourly, half-day, full-day and airport-transfer hire. Enquire on WhatsApp or request a quote for an exact price based on your dates and requirements.

q2.question: Is chauffeur service included with {name}?
q2.answer: Yes — every {name} booking includes a professional, uniformed chauffeur. This is a chauffeur-driven service; self-drive is not available.

q3.question: Can I book {name} for airport transfers?
q3.answer: Yes. The {name} is available for DXB and DWC airport transfers with flight tracking and a meet-and-greet as standard, so your chauffeur adjusts pickup time to your actual landing.

q4.question: Is hourly hire available for {name}?
q4.answer: Yes — the {name} can be booked hourly, by the half-day or full-day, in addition to point-to-point transfers. Pricing for each duration is shown in the packages above.

q5.question: Can I book {name} for business meetings?
q5.answer: Yes. The {name} is a popular choice for corporate travel — client pickups, roadshows, and back-to-back meetings — with a chauffeur who can wait on standby between stops.

q6.question: How far in advance should I book {name}?
q6.answer: Same-day and next-day bookings are often possible, but we recommend booking at least 24–48 hours ahead where you can, and further in advance for weddings, events, or peak dates.
